title: SystemConnectionResponse
description: Response schema for GET /api/system/connection providing externally accessible connection info and Wi-Fi SSID

serverUrl.description: Full HTTP URL reachable on the local or external network for mobile clients

port.description: Active listening port for the server

displayEndpoint.description: Concise ip:port display string shown underneath the QR code

ssid.description: Name of the connected Wi-Fi network or N/A
